name: Leda
personality: Charismatic musician, by turns cunning, flirtatious, warm-hearted, or ruthless.
story: A musician of House Cohendia whose father Guillermo, viceroy of Cydonia in Arago, died in 1444; she fled with Buccar and hid in Ortill for years. She joins the Heroic Games to take revenge on those responsible, then realizes how destructive vengeance is and travels in search of a new purpose. She earned the title Rose of Caelus at 13 by defeating Olympia at the Festival of Roses.

personalSkill.name: Blindside
personalSkill.effect: If unit attacks first, foe cannot counter during combat (5% trigger).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: fastest lord; her route gives the best free roster. Games with James: S tier (character).

build.notes: Hunter (automatic, Ch 5), Rogue (Ch 6 to 8, In Shadow), Dancer from Ch 9 with the Necklace. The Arena Infantry course lands Bow B and Sword B; Dancer trains Sword +3 a fight toward The Apsara's Sword A. No side trips: Dance is worth more than any mastery.

guide.role: Lord and Dancer: a second action for the best attacker every turn
guide.summary: The army's engine. From Ch 9 she dances Sirocco, Guzran or Inyoni for a second action, or sings Song of Passion+ over 3 or more attackers; before that she fights at range 2 with bows. Dance from one tile behind the target and end outside the danger line: she is the defeat condition.
guide.playstyle: Each turn is a Dance or a Song, never both. Sing Passion+ when 3+ attackers fit in her 2-tile ring, Icewater+ before an enemy phase the tanks can't dodge; otherwise dance the unit that can kill again. With nobody to dance, poke with Toxic Wind or the Wooden Bow +5 from range 2.

Stay Rogue Ch 6 to 8 (Mov 6, In Shadow); no side trip, the Arena covers both ranks
Deliver Hingosh to Baina Oasis on the first Ch 9 trip: Dancer's Necklace, no exam
Dance Sirocco, then Guzran, then Inyoni; Esmeralda after a Hammer kill on armor maps
Hand the Mini Bow and Archer's Ring to Inyoni the day she joins (Ch 10 week 1)
Do Captain's and Popular Drink Recipes in Ch 9: Icewater+ and Passion+ (+7)

guide.alt: Ranger (carried in from Dietrich; Spd 80, Countershot) is the fighting fallback if the Necklace is missed. Myrmidon (Sword +2 a fight) only if Sword B is still short in late Ch 8. Shadow Seeker (Bow A, Sword A) is the Part III fallback if the Muses' Necklace isn't found.

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Sirocco, Buccar, Mu, Olympia, Guzran and Esmeralda (plus Jester, filler). Once recruiting is done (Ch 11 and 12): Leda + Sirocco + Olympia, Leda + Mu + Guzran, Leda + Esmeralda + Dadao.
Dancer needs Bow B, Sword B and the Necklace (Hingosh to Baina Oasis, Ch 9; due 10/15?). No exam, no License. Arena Infantry Training from Ch 5 lands both ranks.

Dance uses the action a Song would. Dance order: Sirocco, Guzran, Inyoni; Esmeralda after a Hammer kill on armored maps. Improviso (Lv 35) adds an attack after a Song in Overblaze, never a second Dance.

Four Tavern requests in order: Simple (Sweet Leaves) for Song of Madness, Captain's (Pepper Leaves) for Icewater+, Popular (Bitter Leaves) for Passion+, Elegant (Wonder Leaves, Renown 10) for Song of Angels. Pepper and Bitter Leaves: Traveler's Garden, past Port of Pandora?
No stat check: Leda travels and performs for Renown, gold, crates and Leaves. Clear each batch before it expires (5/28, 9/1, 10/15, 11/27); the trips also buy the strikers' gear.

decisions.why: The Arena takes Sword and Bow to B, and Dancer itself trains Sword +3 toward The Apsara's A. Myrmidon's Spd +15 equals Rogue's, Ravaging Arts never gets a slot on a dancer, and she'd lose her bows.
decisions.else: Myrmidon for a few fights only if Sword B lags in late Ch 8

decisions.pick: Dancer from Ch 9 to Part III
decisions.why: Dance is the army's engine and costs no exam or License; one unit holds it. Ranger is carried in from Dietrich's run but a chapter without Dance costs more than a 50% bow counter.

decisions.topic: Sing for three, dance for one
decisions.pick: Song when 3+ attackers fit in the ring; otherwise Dance
decisions.why: Passion+ gives Str/Mag +7 to everyone within 2; a Dance gives one unit a whole second turn. Three swings at +7 beat one extra action; one or two don't.

decisions.pick: Mini Bow and Archer's Ring to Inyoni
decisions.why: Leda carries them while she trains bows; Inyoni needs range-1 counters and Hit +5 once she joins, and a dancer has no weight to spare.

gates.text: Leda needs Bow B and Sword B for Dancer: Arena Infantry Training weekly from Ch 5
